defect_as_found.statement: The author path enforced class/family coherence, but V556RuleMaterialRegistry.build never consulted the schema class at all.
defect_as_found.proof: A probe inspected the registry build body and reported build_body_mentions_schema_class = false and build_body_mentions_class_family_map = false, while the author body did reference the map. The coherence ceiling therefore existed at exactly one of two publication surfaces.
defect_as_found.risk: A hand-built GovernedRule with internally consistent hashes could carry a result_schema semantic_class its own family does not authorize and reach GOVERNED_RULES_PRESENT.

repair.mechanism: A single named coherence decision, _refuse_if_class_family_mismatch, now used by BOTH publication surfaces.

derivation_requirements_met.schema_class_from_validated_contract_not: At registry build the class is read as _plain(r.result_contract)['result_schema']['semantic_class'] AFTER validate_result_contract_binding(r.result_contract) has run. It is not read from a caller-supplied field and not taken from a parameter.
derivation_requirements_met.authorizing_family_from_the_rule_itself: At registry build the family is read from rule_plain['semantic_family'], i.e. the rule body. The GovernedRule.semantic_family dataclass attribute is NOT trusted for this decision, even though it is separately cross-checked against the rule body.
derivation_requirements_met.placement_after_contract_binding_validat: The gate is invoked after validate_result_contract_binding in the build body, as the commission requires. A court assertion enforces this ordering.
derivation_requirements_met.tranche_local_and_authority_derived: The decision reads only TRANCHE_LOCAL_ADMITTED_SCHEMA_CLASS_FAMILY_MAP, which maps each admitted class to the family that authorizes it. No new class and no new family was introduced.
derivation_requirements_met.no_invented_ontology: Confirmed. The map is unchanged from HQ211: OBJECTIVE_STRUCTURAL_RESULT, OBJECTIVE_WORLD_STATUS and OBJECTIVE_MEASUREMENT, each authorized by V556_TOPOLOGY.

two_failure_modes_refused.mismatch: The class is mapped, but the mapping names a different family than the rule declares.
two_failure_modes_refused.unmapped_class: The class is authorized by no governed family at all.

honest_observability_limitation.finding: In this tranche a class/family mismatch is UNCONSTRUCTIBLE with an authorable family, so the registry gate is shadowed by the tranche-local family ceiling for every mismatch that can actually be built.
honest_observability_limitation.why: All three admitted classes are authorized by V556_TOPOLOGY, and V556_TOPOLOGY is the only authorable family in this tranche. Therefore the set of (class, family) pairs that are simultaneously (a) genuinely mismatched and (b) carry an authorable family is empty by construction of the authority-derived map.
honest_observability_limitation.probe_evidence: A hand-built, consistently rehashed rule carrying V556_INTERACTION_RELATION or V556_ATTRACTOR_PREREQUISITE with a genuinely mismatched class IS constructible, and IS refused by registry build - but by the family ceiling, not by the coherence gate.
honest_observability_limitation.verified_by_experiment: Removing the registry coherence call left the end-to-end mismatch test PASSING, which proves the shadowing rather than assuming it.
honest_observability_limitation.consequence_for_evidence: The coherence gate is proved by two other means that were each verified to fail when the gate is broken: a behavioural test of the decision on real mismatched pairs, and a structural wiring test proving registry build invokes the decision after contract validation.
honest_observability_limitation.this_is_not_over_closing: The gate is defence in depth that becomes live the moment a second family is admitted to the map. It is not dead code, and it is not claimed to be currently untriggerable in a way that would mislead a reviewer.

fail_capability_proofs.result: still PASSED - this is the shadowing limitation, disclosed above rather than presented as evidence

preservation.coherent_pairs_still_accepted: test_d1_registry_build_still_accepts_a_coherent_pair proves the gate is not blanket refusal: all three admitted classes still build a GOVERNED_RULES_PRESENT registry for V556_TOPOLOGY.
preservation.authoring_uses_the_same_decision: The author path was refactored to call the shared helper rather than keep a private duplicate, so the two surfaces cannot drift apart again.
